assumptions.choice: Maintain a rolling deque (maxlen=N=100) of the per-bar sequence-length value computed at every bar; 'becomes a record' means the current sequence length is strictly greater than the maximum value in that deque (built from prior bars only, not including the current bar).
assumptions.reason: Spec states the series length must 'become a record over the last N bars' but does not define the exact windowing mechanic; comparing the current run length to the max of the last N recorded per-bar lengths is the most literal reading.

assumptions.choice: seq_len resets to 0 the instant the joint condition (Close[t]>=Close[t-1] and SMA10[t]>=SMA10[t-1]) fails, and restarts counting from 1 on the next bar where the condition holds again (standard consecutive-run counter).
assumptions.reason: Spec defines the sequence-indicator conceptually but not its exact increment/reset mechanics; this is the standard interpretation of 'length of the current continuous series'.
Spec explicitly labels the trend filter as optional ('optionally, a trend filter can be added'), so it is not a mandated rule; adding it would introduce an extra filter the spec does not require.

assumptions.choice: Called self.addminperiod(sma_period + 1) so next() only begins once SMA10[-1] is a valid (fully warmed) value, since the strategy manually indexes sma10[-1] beyond backtrader's automatic indicator minperiod detection.
assumptions.reason: Needed to safely evaluate the joint condition without referencing an un-warmed SMA(10) value on the first eligible bar; this extends the automatic minperiod mechanism rather than introducing manual bar-skipping logic.
